decisions.reason: Changing location-specific branding and wording within a shared template does not change the established Shatter House brand name or Ridgehaven brand identity.
The packages-and-pricing consistency is independently and completely established by its existing message 42 INTRODUCE Event; the visual-template change requires no additional propagation.
Reusing one layout across location websites does not change which legacy content, images, or booking information are reused from the Harbor Valley site.
The shared layout decision does not change the master website domain or any domain-to-website mapping.
Using a common template across sites does not change the master site's location-selection and routing behavior.
The source decision does not alter Harbor Valley site availability during transition or its linkage from the master site.
The necessary impact is already captured by the existing message 42 MODIFY setting the location template strategy to reuse the same structure with location-specific branding and wording.
A shared layout template does not alter the architecture in which each location has its own Wix website connected through the master site.
Visual and content consistency across websites does not change the requirement for separate revenue and sales tracking by location.
The shared-template decision does not change separate booking management for each location.
The source message does not change the SEO-preservation goal or migration-handling requirements.
Sharing a website structure does not change the requirement that each location retain its own Wix account.
